description: Conversion table (Documentation/BUILD_SYSTEM_CONDENSED.md section 8): status-to-status conversions on the target, owned by skill nodes (owner = customEffectId). Each row is a coded ONCONNECT rule of the node that owns it (Code/Combat/Rules/SkillRules.cs), resolved in the rule engine's order: early rows in the gain phase, late rows after. requires: target statuses that must be up (live intensity / turns). chance: 'power' = the owner's rank x power. repeatOnCrit: passes on a critical. consume / produce units: a number, 'all', or 'half:<store>' (half the live amount before consuming, at least 1). Step 11 (2026-11-22): rows that read Poison or Slow (retired) now read Bleed / Stagger; Kindle has no owning node. DoTs are queued (they land on the target's next tick).
